newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech FinMin tender ave yield dips to 28.98 pct.
newsitem.headline: Czech FinMin tender ave yield dips to 28.98 pct.

text.p: The average yield in the Czech National Bank's (CNB) sell and buy tender on Tuesday for the Finance Ministry dipped to 28.98 percent from 31.34 percent on Monday, the CNB said.
The CNB said in a statement that all bids in the American- style tender at the maximum rate of 29 percent were accepted.
The CNB did not reveal the amount on offer in the tender, nor did it say how many bids it received.
It is the second consecutive day the CNB has held such an operation for the Finance Ministry.
The ministry has been strapped for cash in recent days due to what it says are problems in Czech legislation which limit its short-term borrowing capabilities to 16 billion crowns.
